First release candidate of nitpicker, a quality gate for code written by coding agents. It narrows each language to one allowed way of doing each thing and fails a change only for the problems it adds.

This is a pre-release: rules, messages and config keys can still change before 0.1.0. It is not on npm yet; install it from the tarball attached here.

## Presets

- `typescript` (default), with React rules
- `javascript`
- `python`
- `java`, with Spring rules
- `kotlin`

## Install

Node.js 22.14 or newer and a Git repository. For a TypeScript project:

```sh
npm install --save-dev https://github.com/jhonDoe15/nitpicker/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc.1/nitpicker-0.1.0-rc.1.tgz vitest @vitest/coverage-v8 typescript @types/node
npx nitpicker
```

For another language, set the preset in `nitpicker.config.json`, for example `{ "preset": "python" }`, and install the peers its guide lists.

To pin the exact file and check it, download it with its checksum and keep it in your repository:

```sh
gh release download v0.1.0-rc.1 --repo jhonDoe15/nitpicker --pattern 'nitpicker-*.tgz' --pattern SHA256SUMS --dir vendor
(cd vendor && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS && rm SHA256SUMS)
npm install --save-dev ./vendor/nitpicker-0.1.0-rc.1.tgz vitest @vitest/coverage-v8 typescript @types/node
```

## Agent skills

The tarball carries one skill per preset. Install the one for your project:

```sh
npx skills add ./node_modules/nitpicker --skill nitpicker-typescript
```

See the [README](https://github.com/jhonDoe15/nitpicker/blob/v0.1.0-rc.1/README.md) and the [usage guide](https://github.com/jhonDoe15/nitpicker/blob/v0.1.0-rc.1/docs/usage.md) for configuration, CI setup and adopting nitpicker on existing code.
